takes.title: Walk Forward at a Steady Pace
takes.actionDescription: Already mid-stride, the performer walks forward with an easy arm swing and remains in stride through the last frame.

takes.title: Walk Forward with Longer Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer is already walking when the take opens and takes long, even strides with a pronounced arm swing. The take ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Hold a Bent-Knee Pose with Arms Raised
takes.actionDescription: The performer holds a wide stance with bent knees, one forearm extended outward and the other hand near the head. The pose is essentially unchanged across the two captured frames.

takes.title: Gesture in Place, Bend, and Reach Overhead
takes.actionDescription: The performer stands nearly in place, gestures with both hands, folds forward at the waist and straightens, then reaches overhead and continues gesturing at chest and face height. The arms lower at the end.

takes.title: Jog Forward with Quick Strides
takes.actionDescription: The performer is already jogging as the clip opens, taking quick alternating strides with bent elbows. The motion ends mid-stride.

takes.title: Jump and Steady the Landing
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer crouches, swings the arms, and springs upward. They absorb the landing through bent knees and make a small adjustment before standing still.

takes.sourceDescription: bend over, scoop up, rise, lift arm
takes.title: Reach Low and Lift an Arm
takes.actionDescription: The performer repeatedly bends or crouches to reach toward the floor, then straightens and brings one hand up toward the face or overhead. The movement finishes upright with the arms lowered.

takes.title: Long Jump Forward
takes.actionDescription: From standing, the performer dips and swings the arms, leaps forward, and lands in a deep crouch. They straighten and settle into standing.

takes.title: Walk and Turn Left
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, takes several forward steps, then turns left roughly a quarter turn and keeps walking through the final frame.

takes.title: Walk and Turn Right
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts mid-stride, takes several forward steps, then turns right roughly a quarter turn and keeps walking through the final frame.

takes.title: Sweep Both Arms Up and Out
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, alternates wide two-handed sweeps and overhead reaches with smaller motions near the head and chest, and leans forward several times. The take ends with one hand extended at waist height.

takes.title: Raise Both Hands and Gesture at Chest Height
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with one hand extended, then raises both arms above shoulder height and spreads them to the sides. The gestures grow smaller and end with both hands near the chest.

takes.title: Alternate Wide Gestures with Still Pauses
takes.actionDescription: Beginning with arms lowered, the performer draws the hands in, bends and reaches to the sides, and lifts both hands overhead with pauses between gestures. The performer returns to standing with arms down.

takes.title: Gesture with Side Leans and Knee Bends
takes.actionDescription: The performer begins with knees bent and arms open, then leans to each side, reaches upward, and makes smaller chest-level gestures. They dip into a shallow crouch and straighten near the end.

takes.title: Lean, Crouch, and Raise Both Arms
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright and changes between hand-to-face gestures, deep side leans, and wide overhead reaches. A pronounced crouch near the end leads back to standing with arms lowered.

takes.sourceDescription: vignettes - walk, drink water, run/jog, jump, wipe window, lift open window, throw punches, yawn, stretch
takes.title: Walk, Turn, and Perform Short Gestures
takes.actionDescription: The performer starts upright, raises a hand toward the face, and alternates walking and turns with brief hand motions and overhead reaches. The take finishes with several walking steps and a final turn.

segments.title: Hand near face and first turns

takes.sourceDescription: walk around, sit, stand up, and running
takes.title: Walk, Bend the Knees, and Jog
takes.actionDescription: The performer opens with walking and turns, pauses for repeated knee bends and weight shifts, then walks again before leaning sideways and breaking into quicker running steps. The final stretch returns to walking.

segments.title: Repeated knee bends and weight shifts

takes.sourceDescription: walking, dragging, sweeping, dustpan, wipe window, and wipe mirror
takes.title: Mime a Series of Cleaning Tasks
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks and turns, bends to make repeated low reaching and sweeping motions, then straightens for repeated one-handed wiping motions. They walk again at the end; the CMU source describes sweeping and wiping.
